kernel: REAL source-built lmcache c_ops.single_layer_kv_transfer (published CacheBlend gather), summed over 28 layers
format: NL_X_TWO_NB_BS_NH_HS (live vLLM PagedAttention, discovered via normalize_kv_and_discover_format)
headline: With the REAL published lmcache CacheBlend GATHER kernel on live vLLM PagedAttention, CDC contiguous gather is cheaper than PIC scattered gather in ALL 12 cells, every CI95 EXCLUDES 1.0 (PIC/CDC 1.01-1.27x). Smallest margins at low-inj/seq 8k corner (1.01-1.07x); largest at large-ctx low-inj/seq (28k/0.5%=1.27x).
pic_over_cdc_range: 1.011 (8k/0.5%) .. 1.265 (28k/0.5%); all CI exclude 1.0 except 8k/0.5% (CI [0.994,1.028] includes 1.0 = statistical tie at the smallest corner)
interpretation: SETTLES VERDICT-0037 for the GATHER component. The EXP-0027 ORACLE predicted CDC LOSES at low inj/seq vs a ZERO-OVERHEAD fused PIC; the REAL lmcache kernel still pays scatter/page-gather cost the oracle assumed away, so CDC's contiguous gather WINS 12/12 (ties at the very smallest 8k/0.5% corner). So the bracket resolves in CDC's favor on the gather axis: real-kernel result is CLOSER to the re-impl (EXP-0026, CDC wins) than to the oracle (EXP-0027, CDC loses low).
scope_caveat: This measures the GATHER-KERNEL cost (the KV-transfer component) summed over layers, NOT full end-to-end TTFT incl the selective-attention recompute FLOPs. EXP-0026 measured E2E TTFT (CDC won 12/12 vs re-impl); EXP-0030 isolates the real-kernel gather (CDC wins 12/12). A single combined real-lmcache E2E-TTFT cell would be the final tie-down, but gather + E2E both now favor CDC with the real kernel.
